Script.name: retromud
Script.script:
-- 10_rm: namespace, version, lifecycle, event wiring. -- Contract (docs/design.md): one global namespace `rm`, nothing else leaks. -- Load/install (sysLoadEvent, sysInstall) runs rm.start(), which runs the -- init functions other modules appended to rm.inits (they build their -- temp triggers/aliases/UI). sysUninstallPackage runs rm.stop(), which -- kills every registered handler/trigger/alias id. Every id a module -- creates must be tracked here via rm.on / rm.alias so teardown is total.
-- Re-running the script (Mudlet re-executes it on save): tear down first. local wasStarted = rm and rm.started if rm and rm.stop then rm.stop() end rm = {} rm.restart = wasStarted rm.name = "retromud" rm.version = "0.0.1" rm.inits = {} rm.started = false rm.mapping = false rm.ids = { handler = {}, trigger = {}, alias = {} }
-- One tagged line per message: "[rmap] text". level colours the tag: -- "ok" green, "skip" yellow, "err" red, nil cyan, "plain" no tag, and -- "markup" no tag with the caller's own cecho colours (help body). -- Output can land on the prompt's line, so start a new line first -- when the last line already has text. -- getLines(from, to) excludes `to` (checked live), hence last + 1 local COLOR = { ok = "green", skip = "yellow", err = "red" } function rm.out(text, level) local last = getLastLineNumber("main") local cur = getLines(last, last + 1)[1] if cur and cur ~= "" then echo("\n") end if level ~= "markup" then text = text:gsub("<", "<<") end if level == "plain" or level == "markup" then cecho(text .. "\n") else cecho("<" .. (COLOR[level] or "cyan") .. ">[rmap]<reset> " .. text .. "\n") end end
function rm.on(event, fn) local id = registerAnonymousEventHandler(event, fn) rm.ids.handler[#rm.ids.handler + 1] = id return id end
function rm.alias(pattern, fn) -- unverified: tempAlias accepts a Lua function as its code argument local id = tempAlias(pattern, fn) rm.ids.alias[#rm.ids.alias + 1] = id return id end
function rm.start() if rm.started then return end rm.started = true for i = 1, #rm.inits do rm.inits[i]() end end
function rm.stop() for i = 1, #rm.ids.handler do killAnonymousEventHandler(rm.ids.handler[i]) end for i = 1, #rm.ids.trigger do killTrigger(rm.ids.trigger[i]) end for i = 1, #rm.ids.alias do killAlias(rm.ids.alias[i]) end rm.job = nil if rm.ids.timer then killTimer(rm.ids.timer) end -- the one documented global exception (see 60_speedwalk) if doSpeedWalk == rm.speedwalk then doSpeedWalk = nil end rm.ids = { handler = {}, trigger = {}, alias = {} } rm.started = false end
rm.on("sysLoadEvent", function() rm.start() end) -- unverified: sysInstall is raised with (event, packageName) after an -- .mpackage install, and after this script body has already run rm.on("sysInstall", function(_, pkg) if pkg == rm.name then rm.start() end end) rm.on("sysUninstallPackage", function(_, pkg) if pkg == rm.name then rm.stop() end end)
-- 20_settings: defaults + merge/load/save of user overrides. -- Contract (docs/design.md): defaults in code, user overrides merged from -- a table.save'd file in the profile dir; per-character prompt/exits -- patterns; persisted UI geometry. No behavior. Phase 0 holds defaults -- only; persistence arrives with the first setting that needs it.
rm.settings = { -- Fallback prompt pattern (Lua pattern), used when the connection -- sends no GA and by offline replay. Not end-anchored. See -- docs/output-format.md "Prompt patterns". promptPattern = "^Hp:%s*%d+/%d+%s+Sp:%s*%d+/%d+%s+Ep:%s*%d+/%d+",
-- Exits grammar (docs/output-format.md "Exits grammar"). The solo -- pattern is lazy so the trailing period is not captured. exitsMulti = "^Obvious exits are:%s+(.*)", exitsSolo = "^The only obvious exit is%s+(%S-)%.?%s*$",
-- Noise lines skipped when looking for the room title. ignore = { "^You are flying%.$", "^.- starts using ", "^ %*%*%* NEW ROUND %*%*%*", "^%-%-%- HP:", "^You hit ", "^You do not hit ", "^You attack ", " fails to hit you%.$", " hits you ", "is DEAD, R%.I%.P%.$", "^You can act again%.$", "^The clouds begin to break apart", },
-- Lines buffered with no prompt before reporting "no usable prompt". maxBlockLines = 500,
-- Seconds before an unresolved expectation is dropped (a silent or -- failed command must never stall the queue). expectTimeout = 10,
-- Command classification (docs/mapper-protocol.md). First word of -- the sent command; extend during calibration. verifyVerbs = { look = true, l = true, glance = true }, previewVerbs = { peer = true, scry = true },
-- Lines that cancel the head expectation (a move that did not move). moveFail = { "^You can't go that way!" },
-- Fingerprint search radius (Chebyshev) for non-Euclidean links. maxSearchDistance = 5, -- Freeform verbs that are vertical in meaning: layers to climb (layout -- only; the link is by room id either way). freeformDz = { climb = 1 }, areaName = "RetroMUD",
-- Cardinal directions: abbreviation, Mudlet direction number -- (setExit/setExitStub), coordinate delta, opposite. in/out are not -- here: they have no delta, so they are freeform (special) exits. dirs = { north = { abbr = "n", num = 1, dx = 0, dy = 1, dz = 0, opp = "south" }, northeast = { abbr = "ne", num = 2, dx = 1, dy = 1, dz = 0, opp = "southwest" }, northwest = { abbr = "nw", num = 3, dx = -1, dy = 1, dz = 0, opp = "southeast" }, east = { abbr = "e", num = 4, dx = 1, dy = 0, dz = 0, opp = "west" }, west = { abbr = "w", num = 5, dx = -1, dy = 0, dz = 0, opp = "east" }, southeast = { abbr = "se", num = 7, dx = 1, dy = -1, dz = 0, opp = "northwest" }, southwest = { abbr = "sw", num = 8, dx = -1, dy = -1, dz = 0, opp = "northeast" }, south = { abbr = "s", num = 6, dx = 0, dy = -1, dz = 0, opp = "north" }, up = { abbr = "u", num = 9, dx = 0, dy = 0, dz = 1, opp = "down" }, down = { abbr = "d", num = 10, dx = 0, dy = 0, dz = -1, opp = "up" }, }, }
-- 30_capture: line buffer -> room-block detection -> rm.onRoom event. -- Contract (docs/design.md, docs/output-format.md): rm.onLine(line) is -- called once per received line (a trigger live, the replay harness -- offline). Segments end at a prompt: isPrompt() (GA/EOR) live, else -- rm.settings.promptPattern. Each exits line in a segment raises -- raiseEvent("rm.onRoom", {name=, exits={...}, lines={...}, -- fingerprint=}), then rm.onSegment(n); a move-fail line raises -- rm.onMoveFail. Knows nothing about the map.
rm.cap = { buf = {}, warned = false }
local function isNoise(line) if line:find("^%s*$") then return true end for i = 1, #rm.settings.ignore do if line:find(rm.settings.ignore[i]) then return true end end return false end
-- Exits starting at buf[i]: returns exits list, index of last line. local function parseExits(buf, i) local s = rm.settings local solo = buf[i]:match(s.exitsSolo) if solo then return { solo:lower() }, i end local rest = buf[i]:match(s.exitsMulti) if not rest then return nil end local j = i while not rest:find("%.%s*$") do j = j + 1 if not buf[j] then return nil end if not isNoise(buf[j]) then rest = rest .. " " .. buf[j] end end local exits = {} for part in rest:gsub("%.%s*$", ""):gmatch("[^,]+") do local name = part:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$"):gsub("^and%s+", ""):lower() if name ~= "" then exits[#exits + 1] = name end end return exits, j end
local function fingerprint(name, exits) local sorted = {} for i = 1, #exits do sorted[i] = exits[i] end table.sort(sorted) return name .. "|" .. table.concat(sorted, ",") end
-- Walk back from each exits line to the description start (first -- exactly-two-space-indented line, which may be just the two spaces; -- deeper indents are list continuations); the title is the non-noise -- line above it. local function scan(buf) local lo, i = 1, 1 while i <= #buf do local exits, last = parseExits(buf, i) if exits then local d = i - 1 while d >= lo and not (buf[d]:find("^ %S") or buf[d] == " ") do d = d - 1 end if d < lo then -- shortcut: builders may indent the first line 3+ spaces; -- nearest such line wins, so a deeper-indented mid-description -- line can be mistaken for the start. Upgrade if seen. d = i - 1 while d >= lo and not buf[d]:find("^ +%S") do d = d - 1 end end local t = d - 1 -- an indented line above the 2-space line is the description's -- real first line (e.g. a 4-space "You have arrived..."), not a title while t >= lo and (isNoise(buf[t]) or buf[t]:find("^%s+%S")) do t = t - 1 end if d >= lo and t >= lo then local lines = {} for k = t, last do lines[#lines + 1] = buf[k] end raiseEvent("rm.onRoom", { name = buf[t], exits = exits, lines = lines, fingerprint = fingerprint(buf[t], exits), }) end lo, i = last + 1, last + 1 else i = i + 1 end end end
-- Raises rm.onRoom per room, then rm.onSegment(n) with the count of -- non-noise lines, so the tracker can close commands that print no room. local function flush() local buf = rm.cap.buf rm.cap.buf = {} scan(buf) local n = 0 for i = 1, #buf do if not isNoise(buf[i]) then n = n + 1 end end raiseEvent("rm.onSegment", n) end
function rm.onLine(line) local c = rm.cap if isPrompt() or line:find(rm.settings.promptPattern) then c.warned = false flush() return end for i = 1, #rm.settings.moveFail do if line:find(rm.settings.moveFail[i]) then raiseEvent("rm.onMoveFail") break end end c.buf[#c.buf + 1] = line if #c.buf > rm.settings.maxBlockLines then if not c.warned then c.warned = true rm.out("no usable prompt (no GA, and the prompt " .. "pattern never matched in " .. #c.buf .. " lines); " .. "set rm.settings.promptPattern", "err") end flush() end end
rm.inits[#rm.inits + 1] = function() -- unverified: tempRegexTrigger("^", fn) fires for every line, and -- the global `line` holds the current line inside fn local id = tempRegexTrigger("^", function() rm.onLine(line) end) rm.ids.trigger[#rm.ids.trigger + 1] = id end
-- 40_tracker: expectation queue and sync state. -- Contract (docs/design.md, docs/mapper-protocol.md): sysDataSendRequest -- pushes one classified expectation (VERIFY / PREVIEW / ADVANCE / -- MAYBE_MOVE) per sent command; sync state is SYNCED / UNSYNCED / -- PENDING; each rm.onRoom block resolves the queue head. Decides -- advance/verify/preview. Never writes the graph (rm.build does). -- Rules 3 and 4 of the protocol hold by construction: T.send below is -- the only function that pushes onto the queue; no module calls -- sendSocket or pushes directly.
rm.track = { q = {}, pos = nil, handled = false, following = false } local T = rm.track
-- name or abbreviation -> full direction name local dirAlias = {} for name, d in pairs(rm.settings.dirs) do dirAlias[name] = name dirAlias[d.abbr] = name end
function rm.now() return os.time() end
local function classify(cmd) local word = cmd:match("^(%S+)") if rm.settings.verifyVerbs[word] then return "VERIFY" end if rm.settings.previewVerbs[word] then return "PREVIEW" end if dirAlias[cmd] then return "ADVANCE", dirAlias[cmd] end return "MAYBE_MOVE" end
-- An expectation can carry cb(block_or_nil, why): called when it -- resolves (block), is cancelled (nil, "fail"), closed with no room -- (nil) or expires (nil, "timeout"). Used by speedwalk/scan/where. local function done(e, b, why) if e and e.cb then e.cb(b, why) end end
local function expire() local cutoff = rm.now() - rm.settings.expectTimeout local dead = {} while T.q[1] and T.q[1].t < cutoff do dead[#dead + 1] = table.remove(T.q, 1) end for i = 1, #dead do done(dead[i], nil, "timeout") end end
-- SYNCED / PENDING / UNSYNCED (PENDING = synced with a command in flight) function T.state() if not T.pos then return "UNSYNCED" end if #T.q > 0 then return "PENDING" end return "SYNCED" end
-- Rule 1 and 2: skip empty commands, one expectation per embedded line. function T.send(_, cmd) for raw in (tostring(cmd) .. "\n"):gmatch("(.-)\r?\n") do local part = raw:lower():match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") if part ~= "" then expire() local kind, dir = classify(part) T.q[#T.q + 1] = { kind = kind, cmd = part, dir = dir, t = rm.now(), cb = T.hook } T.hook = nil -- unverified: `follow` syntax; "follow self"/"unfollow" end it local verb, arg = part:match("^(%S+)%s*(%S*)") if verb == "follow" then T.following = arg ~= "" and arg ~= "self" elseif verb == "unfollow" then T.following = false end end end end
-- Internal sends (speedwalk, scan, where) go through send() so that -- T.send above still pushes the expectation; cb rides on it. function T.exec(cmd, cb) T.hook = cb -- unverified: sysDataSendRequest handlers run synchronously in send() send(cmd) T.hook = nil -- a silent game must not stall a job: expire() runs from this timer if rm.ids.timer then killTimer(rm.ids.timer) end -- unverified: tempTimer(seconds, fn) returns a timer id for killTimer rm.ids.timer = tempTimer(rm.settings.expectTimeout + 1, expire) end
local function resolve(e, b) if e.kind == "PREVIEW" then return end local cur = T.pos if not cur then -- never guess: only a unique fingerprint match re-syncs T.pos = rm.build.find(b.fingerprint) elseif e.kind == "ADVANCE" then T.pos = rm.build.advance(cur, e.dir, b) elseif rm.build.fp(cur) == b.fingerprint then -- VERIFY / no move return elseif e.kind == "VERIFY" then T.pos = rm.build.find(b.fingerprint) else T.pos = rm.build.special(cur, e.cmd, b) end end
-- Keep the Mudlet map pane on the player's room (it follows the area). -- unverified: centerview(id) switches the pane to that room's area. function T.focus() if T.pos then centerview(T.pos) end end
function T.onRoom(_, b) expire() T.handled = true local e = table.remove(T.q, 1) if not e then T.pos = nil return end -- SPONTANEOUS resolve(e, b) T.focus() done(e, b) end
-- A failed move cancels the head expectation; nothing was created on send. function T.onMoveFail() expire() T.handled = true done(table.remove(T.q, 1), nil, "fail") end
-- A prompt closed a segment with n real lines. If no room block and no -- fail message already resolved the head, the head command is done. -- An ADVANCE head is the exception: its ack is the room block or the -- fail line, so unrelated chatter before it must not close it (timeout -- covers a move that prints neither). function T.onSegment(_, n) expire() local e, head = nil, T.q[1] if not T.handled and n > 0 and head and head.kind ~= "ADVANCE" then e = table.remove(T.q, 1) end T.handled = false done(e, nil) end
-- Explicit orphan creation / re-sync entry point (used by `rmap where`). function T.adopt(b) T.pos = rm.build.adopt(b) T.focus() end
rm.inits[#rm.inits + 1] = function() rm.on("sysDataSendRequest", T.send) rm.on("rm.onRoom", T.onRoom) rm.on("rm.onMoveFail", T.onMoveFail) rm.on("rm.onSegment", T.onSegment) end
-- 50_builder: the ONLY module that writes the map graph. -- Contract (docs/design.md, docs/mapper-protocol.md): fingerprint -- matching, coordinate-first dedupe, room/area/exit creation, stub -- semantics, special exits. Each decision function returns the room id -- the player is now in, or nil when the map disagrees with the block -- (the tracker then goes UNSYNCED; nothing is guessed or created). -- Fingerprints persist as room user data "fp".
rm.build = {} local B = rm.build -- Auto-created rooms, newest last: { id, from, dir | cmd } (for undo). B.created = {}
local function areaId() local name = rm.settings.areaName -- unverified: getAreaTable() returns {name = id}; addAreaName returns the id return getAreaTable()[name] or addAreaName(name) end
function B.fp(id) -- unverified: getRoomUserData returns "" when the key is unset return getRoomUserData(id, "fp") end
local function roomAt(x, y, z) -- unverified: getRoomsByPosition(area, x, y, z) returns a table of ids for _, id in pairs(getRoomsByPosition(areaId(), x, y, z)) do return id end end
local function candidates(fp) local out = {} -- unverified: searchRoomUserData(key, value) returns the matching room ids for _, id in pairs(searchRoomUserData("fp", fp)) do if getRoomArea(id) == areaId() then out[#out + 1] = id end end return out end B.candidates = candidates
-- The one room with this fingerprint, or nil if none or ambiguous. function B.find(fp) local c = candidates(fp) if #c == 1 then return c[1] end end
local function link(from, to, dir) local n = rm.settings.dirs[dir].num -- unverified: setExit takes the direction number 1-12 setExit(from, to, n) -- unverified: setExit leaves a stub in place, so clear it setExitStub(from, n, false) end
local function create(b, x, y, z, peer) local id = createRoomID() addRoom(id) setRoomArea(id, areaId()) setRoomName(id, b.name) setRoomCoordinates(id, x, y, z) setRoomUserData(id, "fp", b.fingerprint) setRoomUserData(id, "source", peer and "peer" or "walk") return id end
-- Walking into a peer stub confirms it. local function confirm(id) if getRoomUserData(id, "source") == "peer" then setRoomUserData(id, "source", "walk") end end
-- Listed cardinal exits not linked yet become stubs. Freeform exits -- (gate, leave) have no stub form; they link when first walked. local function stub(id, b) -- unverified: getRoomExits returns {directionName = roomId} local linked = getRoomExits(id) for _, ex in ipairs(b.exits) do local d = rm.settings.dirs[ex] if d and not linked[ex] then setExitStub(id, d.num, true) end end end
-- Existing room one step in dir: a real link first (second result true), -- else whatever sits on the expected cell (a guess; see B.advance). local function neighbor(from, dir) local to = getRoomExits(from)[dir] if to then return to, true end local d = rm.settings.dirs[dir] local x, y, z = getRoomCoordinates(from) return roomAt(x + d.dx, y + d.dy, z + d.dz), false end
-- The grid is only a layout: the MUD's exits need not fit on it. The -- cell (x, y, z) if free, else the nearest free cell on that level that -- is not in `reserved` ("x,y,z" keys), ties broken by distance to the -- source cell (sx, sy) so the room stays close to where it came from. local function freeCell(x, y, z, reserved, sx, sy) reserved = reserved or {} for r = 0, math.huge do local bx, by, bd for i = -r, r do for j = -r, r do local cx, cy = x + i, y + j if math.max(math.abs(i), math.abs(j)) == r and not roomAt(cx, cy, z) and not reserved[cx .. "," .. cy .. "," .. z] then local d = sx and (cx - sx) * (cx - sx) + (cy - sy) * (cy - sy) or 0 if not bd or d < bd then bx, by, bd = cx, cy, d end end end end if bd then return bx, by, z end end end
-- Cells that `from`'s other listed cardinal exits will want, so a nudged -- room does not steal them (a nudge must not force the next nudge). local function reservedFor(from, dir) local out = {} local x, y, z = getRoomCoordinates(from) for ex in (B.fp(from):match("|(.*)$") or ""):gmatch("[^,]+") do local d = rm.settings.dirs[ex] if d and ex ~= dir then out[(x + d.dx) .. "," .. (y + d.dy) .. "," .. (z + d.dz)] = true end end return out end
-- Non-Euclidean link (decision step 2): the single nearby room with this -- fingerprint whose way back toward us is not already linked elsewhere. local function near(from, fp, opp) local x, y, z = getRoomCoordinates(from) local hit for _, id in ipairs(candidates(fp)) do local a, b, c = getRoomCoordinates(id) local back = getRoomExits(id)[opp] -- the room already linked behind us is never "ahead" (a -- corridor of identical rooms would fold back on itself) if id ~= from and (not back or back == from) and getRoomExits(from)[opp] ~= id and math.max(math.abs(a - x), math.abs(b - y), math.abs(c - z)) <= rm.settings.maxSearchDistance then if hit then return nil end -- ambiguous hit = id end end return hit end
-- peer: a `peer` preview from `from` (rmap scan): new rooms are stubs and -- the way back is left as a soft exit stub, never a real link. function B.advance(from, dir, b, peer) local d = rm.settings.dirs[dir] local to, linked = neighbor(from, dir) -- An unlinked room on the expected cell is only a coordinate guess; -- a different room there means the map does not fit the grid, so -- ignore it (links, not cells, are the truth). if to and not linked and B.fp(to) ~= b.fingerprint then to = nil end to = to or near(from, b.fingerprint, d.opp) if to then if B.fp(to) ~= b.fingerprint then return nil end link(from, to, dir) if not peer then confirm(to) end return to end local x, y, z = getRoomCoordinates(from) x, y, z = freeCell(x + d.dx, y + d.dy, z + d.dz, reservedFor(from, dir), x, y) to = create(b, x, y, z, peer) B.created[#B.created + 1] = { id = to, from = from, dir = dir } link(from, to, dir) for _, ex in ipairs(b.exits) do if ex == d.opp and not peer then link(to, from, d.opp) end end stub(to, b) return to end
-- Freeform command (gate, leave, sungate...) that landed in a different -- room: a special exit to a known or new room. function B.special(from, cmd, b, peer) -- unverified: getSpecialExitsSwap(id) returns {command = roomId} local to = getSpecialExitsSwap(from)[cmd] or B.find(b.fingerprint) if to then if B.fp(to) ~= b.fingerprint then return nil end if not peer then confirm(to) end else local x, y, z = getRoomCoordinates(from) local dz = rm.settings.freeformDz[cmd] if dz then x, y, z = freeCell(x, y, z + dz) else repeat x = x + 1 until not roomAt(x, y, z) -- nearest free cell end to = create(b, x, y, z, peer) B.created[#B.created + 1] = { id = to, from = from, cmd = cmd } stub(to, b) end addSpecialExit(from, to, cmd) return to end
-- Orphan room for an explicit sync (`rmap where`); reuses a unique match. function B.adopt(b) local to = B.find(b.fingerprint) if to then return to end local x = 0 while roomAt(x, 0, 0) do x = x + 1 end to = create(b, x, 0, 0) B.created[#B.created + 1] = { id = to } stub(to, b) return to end
-- Remove exactly the newest auto-created room and the link that led to -- it; the exit it came through goes back to a stub. Returns its record. function B.undo() local e = table.remove(B.created) if not e then return nil end if e.dir then local n = rm.settings.dirs[e.dir].num -- unverified: setExit(from, -1, dir) removes the exit setExit(e.from, -1, n) setExitStub(e.from, n, true) elseif e.cmd then -- unverified: removeSpecialExit(id, command) exists removeSpecialExit(e.from, e.cmd) end e.name = getRoomName(e.id) -- unverified: deleteRoom also drops exits other rooms hold into it deleteRoom(e.id) return e end
-- 60_speedwalk: doSpeedWalk() contract and stepping engine. -- Contract (docs/design.md): reads speedWalkDir/speedWalkPath; confirmed -- per step (send, then wait for a resolved block); aborts on move-fail. -- Mudlet calls the global doSpeedWalk() after a path is computed -- (gotoRoom, map clicks): speedWalkDir is the list of commands, -- speedWalkPath the list of room ids each step should land in. It is -- the one global outside `rm` (set at start, cleared by rm.stop). -- A job is one command sequence at a time, tracked in rm.job.
local T = rm.track
-- Shared guard for every job that sends commands (speedwalk, scan, where). function rm.canRun() if T.following then rm.out("refused while following someone", "skip") elseif rm.job then rm.out("busy with " .. rm.job, "skip") else return true end end
function rm.speedwalk() if not rm.canRun() then return end local dirs, path = speedWalkDir, speedWalkPath -- unverified: speedWalkDir/speedWalkPath are tables set by Mudlet -- (path entries may be strings), and speedWalkPath[i] is the room -- reached after step i (the start room is not listed) if type(dirs) ~= "table" or #dirs == 0 then return end rm.job = "speedwalk" local i = 0 local function step() i = i + 1 if i > #dirs then rm.job = nil rm.out("speedwalk: arrived", "ok") return end T.exec(dirs[i], function(b, why) local want = path and tonumber(path[i]) if b and T.pos and (not want or T.pos == want) then return step() end rm.job = nil rm.out("speedwalk stopped at step " .. i .. " (" .. dirs[i] .. "): " .. (why or "unexpected room"), "skip") end) end step() end
rm.inits[#rm.inits + 1] = function() doSpeedWalk = rm.speedwalk end
-- 70_ui: Geyser container, Geyser.Mapper pane, status label, buttons. -- Contract (docs/design.md): geometry persisted via settings; `rmap ui off` -- kill-switch; pure consumer of tracker/builder state. -- Phase 0: empty; implemented in Phase 5.
-- 80_commands: all aliases (`rm <command>`). -- Contract (docs/design.md): rmap start/stop/goto/path/where/scan/undo/fix/ -- save/load/prompt(Phase 6)/exits/fail/debug/ui/reload/help. Pure -- consumer of the other modules. -- Phase 3: where, scan, undo (start/stop only toggle rm.mapping, which -- lets `rmap where` create an orphan room when nothing matches).
rm.commands = {}
function rm.commands.help() rm.out("retromud " .. rm.version .. " - RetroMUD auto-mapper") for _, c in ipairs({ { "rmap help", "show this text" }, { "rmap start|stop", "mapping on/off (where may create a room)" }, { "rmap where", "re-sync position from the room you are in" }, { "rmap scan", "peer every exit of this room and map the stubs" }, { "rmap undo", "remove the last auto-created room" }, }) do rm.out(string.format(" <cyan>%-16s<reset>%s", c[1], c[2]), "markup") end end
local T, B = rm.track, rm.build
function rm.commands.start() rm.mapping = true rm.out("mapping on", "ok") end function rm.commands.stop() rm.mapping = false rm.out("mapping off", "ok") end
local function finish(msg, cb, ok) rm.job = nil T.focus() if msg then rm.out(msg, ok and "ok" or "skip") end if cb then cb(ok) end end
-- Neighbour of room `id` through exit `ex` (linked or special), or nil. local function beyond(id, ex) return getRoomExits(id)[ex] or getSpecialExitsSwap(id)[ex] end
-- Peer each exit of `b` and drop candidate rooms whose known neighbour -- through that exit has another fingerprint. Calls done(room or nil). local function narrow(c, b, i, done) if #c == 1 then return done(c[1]) end local ex = b.exits[i] if not ex then return done(nil) end T.exec("peer " .. ex, function(pb) if pb then local keep = {} for _, id in ipairs(c) do local n = beyond(id, ex) if not n or B.fp(n) == pb.fingerprint then keep[#keep + 1] = id end end c = keep end narrow(c, b, i + 1, done) end) end
-- rmap where: look; unique fingerprint -> synced; several -> disambiguate -- by peering; none -> report (or adopt when mapping). cb(ok) when done. local function where(cb) T.exec("look", function(b) if not b then return finish("where: no room seen", cb, false) end local c = B.candidates(b.fingerprint) if #c == 1 then T.pos = c[1] return finish("where: synced", cb, true) end if #c == 0 then if not rm.mapping then return finish("where: no match in the map", cb, false) end T.adopt(b) return finish("where: created a new room", cb, true) end narrow(c, b, 1, function(id) if not id then return finish("where: could not narrow to one room", cb, false) end T.pos = id finish("where: synced", cb, true) end) end) end
function rm.commands.where() if not rm.canRun() then return end rm.job = "where" where() end
-- rmap scan: peer every exit that is not already linked to a real room. function rm.commands.scan() if not rm.canRun() then return end rm.job = "scan" local function scan() T.exec("look", function(b) local cur = T.pos if not b or not cur or B.fp(cur) ~= b.fingerprint then return finish("scan: position lost", nil) end -- cardinals first: freeform rooms take the nearest free cell -- and must not squat on a cardinal neighbour's cell local order = {} for _, want in ipairs({ true, false }) do for _, ex in ipairs(b.exits) do if (rm.settings.dirs[ex] ~= nil) == want then order[#order + 1] = ex end end end local made, i = 0, 0 local function nextExit() i = i + 1 local ex = order[i] if not ex then return finish("scan: done, " .. made .. " new", nil, true) end local to = beyond(cur, ex) if to and getRoomUserData(to, "source") ~= "peer" then return nextExit() end T.exec("peer " .. ex, function(pb) if pb then local n = #B.created if rm.settings.dirs[ex] then B.advance(cur, ex, pb, true) else B.special(cur, ex, pb, true) end made = made + #B.created - n end nextExit() end) end nextExit() end) end if T.state() ~= "UNSYNCED" then return scan() end where(function(ok) if not ok then return finish("scan: could not sync", nil) end rm.job = "scan" scan() end) end
function rm.commands.undo() local e = B.undo() if not e then return rm.out("undo: nothing to undo", "skip") end if T.pos == e.id then T.pos = nil end rm.out("undo: removed '" .. e.name .. "' (room " .. e.id .. ")", "ok") end
function rm.command(arg) local cmd = arg:match("^%s*(%S*)") if cmd == "" then cmd = "help" end local fn = rm.commands[cmd] if fn then fn() else rm.out("unknown command '" .. cmd .. "'. Try 'rmap help'.", "err") end end
rm.inits[#rm.inits + 1] = function() -- unverified: an unmatched optional group leaves matches[2] nil or "" rm.alias("^rmap( .*)?$", function() rm.command(matches[2] or "") end) end
-- Last module: a script re-run (save in the editor) does not raise -- sysLoadEvent again, so resume if the previous instance was running. if rm.restart then rm.restart = nil rm.start() end
